name: Push tons of boxes
description:
Players are able to push any number of these weightless boxes

One Up command in a 6×6 room; expect exactly 1 tick after Start.
Box 3: 1 cell, starting at (0, 1, 1); Box 2: 1 cell, starting at (0, 2, 1); Box 1: 1 cell, starting at (0, 3, 1); Box 0: 4 cells, starting at (0, 4, 1) through (3, 4, 1); Player: 1 cell, starting at (0, 5, 1); Box 6: 1 cell, starting at (1, 1, 1); Box 5: 1 cell, starting at (1, 2, 1); Box 4: 1 cell, starting at (1, 3, 1); Box 9: 1 cell, starting at (2, 1, 1); Box 8: 1 cell, starting at (2, 2, 1); Box 7: 1 cell, starting at (2, 3, 1); Box 12: 1 cell, starting at (3, 1, 1); Box 11: 1 cell, starting at (3, 2, 1); Box 10: 1 cell, starting at (3, 3, 1). Terrain and fixtures: Limestone.

Tick 1: Box 3 moves 1 north; Box 2 moves 1 north; Box 1 moves 1 north; Box 0 moves 1 north; Player moves 1 north; Box 6 moves 1 north; Box 5 moves 1 north; Box 4 moves 1 north; Box 9 moves 1 north; Box 8 moves 1 north; Box 7 moves 1 north; Box 12 moves 1 north; Box 11 moves 1 north; Box 10 moves 1 north.

Coordinates are (x, y, z); north decreases y. Every frame is checked in all four rotations. Unmentioned objects retain their authored positions and states.
